name: @volt/local-stack
description: Provisioning of a single-user local VOLT stack, the one the web client and the desktop app run in workers of their page (@volt/web-runtime): the environment each backend starts with, the bootstrap that creates the local account, team and cluster, and the default plugin seed. The self-hosting CLI reuses the bootstrap for the stack it deploys with Docker. Raw TypeScript source, no build step, no barrel; it runs in Node and in the browser, with persistence and logging supplied by the caller.
